notes.title: Cross set infinity has been released!
notes.notes:
New series with 3 times more puzzles than previous work, beautiful 19 background music tracks, random puzzles, quicksave, has been released on Steam.

Android and iOS versions also are coming soon.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/705250/Cross_Set_Infinity/
